_note: Learned host→handler map for lib/fetch-jd.mjs. Machine-grown via `node lib/fetch-jd.mjs --learn ...`, NOT hand-edited by the user. Committed on purpose: it is accumulated fetch wisdom that should pass to whoever picks this up next, not per-user state. Each entry maps an otherwise-unrecognised host (or regex) to one of the built-in handlers in fetch-jd.mjs, plus any params the handler can.t pull from the URL (e.g. an org/tenant slug). Consulted before the built-in URL matchers.

Enklare/E2E Group Teamtailor custom domain

Deel custom ATS (Next.js SPA). No __NEXT_DATA__, but embeds full JobPosting JSON-LD in page head — xh GET + python3 JSON-LD extraction works. URL pattern: /deel/job-details/{uuid}/overview. No auth required.
Squarespace careers page fronting Greenhouse board for Slice (pizzeria platform)

SAP SuccessFactors Jobs2Web (j2w) static HTML. xh GET + HTML extraction works (no JS rendering needed). URL shape: /job/{slug}/{job-id}-{locale}/. Redirects from external IDs (e.g. 1398845233) to internal id-locale form (99061-en_GB). No JSON-LD. Needs a j2w handler in fetch-jd.mjs for zero-token support.
Star Stable Entertainment Teamtailor career site

SAP SuccessFactors EU SPA (verp client). No JSON-LD, no unauthenticated OData endpoint. Firecrawl extracts full JD. URL shape: /career?career_ns=job_listing&company={tenant}&career_job_req_id={id}. Other SF tenants (careerXX.successfactors.eu, *.successfactors.com) likely same pattern.
custom domain fronting Greenhouse; canonical URL uses fundraiseup.com/careers/{id}?gh_jid={id}
Bitrefill careers page on Teamtailor

Comeet ATS (AngularJS SPA). No public API; no JSON-LD. Firecrawl renders the SPA and extracts full JD. URL pattern: /jobs/{org}/{company-code}/{role-slug}/{position-code}. Also served from comeet.co (same SPA).

Breezy HR ATS — single-tenant portals ({tenant}.breezy.hr/p/{id}-{slug}). Some tenants embed a full JobPosting JSON-LD (handler tries it first); others (e.g. yallaplay) serve none, only a static-HTML .description block plus twitter:data1/data2 meta tags for location/company — handler falls back to those. No auth required.
Mews careers page (Next.js) fronts Greenhouse; job IDs in path /en/careers/jobs/{gh_jid}

Dover apply SPA (React, Cloudflare Turnstile). No public unauthenticated API — xh returns the SPA shell. Firecrawl renders full JD including role description, requirements, comp, and benefits. URL pattern: app.dover.com/apply/{org}/{uuid}/?rs={ref}. No JSON-LD. Set Fetch-method: firecrawl.

Workable apply subdomain. URL pattern: apply.workable.com/{account}/j/{shortcode}/. Dedicated workable handler in fetch-jd.mjs GETs https://apply.workable.com/{account}/jobs/view/{shortcode}.md — returns clean markdown with title, subtitle (company·location), workplace, department, description. No auth required. Built-in match() fires on the host pattern so no registry override needed, but entry kept for documentation.

Hostaway careers page on Recruitee (careers.recruiteecdn.com CDN). Full JobPosting JSON-LD embedded in static HTML — xh GET + python3 JSON-LD extract works (same as teamtailor). URL pattern: /o/{slug}. IMPORTANT: prose wins over JSON-LD applicantLocationRequirements country list (payroll countries, not eligibility). Set Remote scope from JD prose, not country array. Incident: #279 wrongly Skipped-Location from country list; #1415 correctly used prose EMEA. No auth required.
Sitoo custom Teamtailor domain; JSON-LD embedded in page HTML

Workable public job board (jobs.workable.com). URL pattern: /view/{shortcode}/{slug}. API: GET https://jobs.workable.com/api/v1/jobs/{shortcode} — returns full JSON: .title, .description (HTML), .requirementsSection (HTML), .benefitsSection (HTML), .workplace (remote/hybrid/onsite), .location.countryName, .locations[], .employmentType, .department, .company.title, .state (published/closed), .created, .linkoutUrl (employer ATS if set, else null). No auth required. linkoutUrl is the canonical employer URL when present; fall back to jobs.workable.com URL. Distinct from apply.workable.com which uses a different URL shape and markdown endpoint.
Custom domain fronting Teamtailor (Ants staffing agency, Sweden)
Treebula custom domain fronting Teamtailor
custom domain fronting Lever; job UUID embedded in page JS
Froda careers site on Teamtailor; JSON-LD JobPosting embedded in page
MongoDB careers page fronting Greenhouse; job IDs in URL path /careers/jobs/{id} map directly to gh_jid

Jobylon ATS employer-facing domain (emp.jobylon.com). Full JobPosting JSON-LD embedded in static HTML page. xh GET + python3 JSON-LD extraction works. URL pattern: /jobs/{id}-{company-slug}-{role-slug}. No auth required.

pmsforhire.com is a jboard.io-powered aggregator. Full JobPosting JSON-LD embedded in static HTML page — xh GET + python3 JSON-LD extraction works (second <script type=application/ld+json> block; first is a WebPage type). URL pattern: /jobs/{numericId}-{role-slug}. Apply link goes to /jobs/{numericId}/apply which redirects to employer ATS; however the employer ATS URL is NOT in the JSON-LD or page source — must follow the redirect or check the employer ATS separately. hiringOrganization.name gives the employer name. No auth required. Note: aggregator validThrough dates may outlive the actual posting at the employer ATS.

iCIMS ATS — schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD embedded on posting page, generic xh handler works

Oracle Taleo-style career site (careers.se.com = Schneider Electric). JSON-LD JobPosting embedded in static HTML, xh GET works, no JS rendering needed. URL pattern: /jobs/{id}?lang={locale}. Multi-location postings list several jobLocation entries; generic handler only picks the first. Akamai-fronted: bot-blocks the default Mozilla-style fetch UA on a plain request; params.headers below overrides to an xh-like UA/Accept which passes.
Contentstack CMS behind Next.js; job record in __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.job
Aramisauto custom domain fronting Teamtailor; JSON-LD JobPosting embedded in page HTML
SAP SuccessFactors Career Site Builder (job2web), custom vanity domain; server-rendered data-careersite-propertyid fields

SAP SuccessFactors Career Site Builder (microdata JobPosting, not JSON-LD — the generic 'xh' handler can't parse it without a microdata extractor). Server-rendered plain HTML, so xh GET *does* work manually, but this host has shown a one-off content-mismatch under concurrent load (a raw fetch briefly returned a sibling posting's body while HTTP 200 looked normal; refetching immediately after was consistently correct). Registering as firecrawl (isolated per-call render, matches career5.successfactors.eu precedent) rather than xh to sidestep that risk; Fetch-jd.mjs firecrawl handler leaves location/remoteScope unspecified — fine, the 2b LLM gate reads the prose. URL shape: joinus.canalplus.com/job/{City}-{Contract}-{TITLE}-%28FHX%29/{jobId}.
smartclip Europe GmbH custom domain fronting Teamtailor; JSON-LD JobPosting embedded in page HTML (same pattern as emploi-aramisauto.com)
SAP SuccessFactors Career Site Builder (jobs2web), custom vanity domain; server-rendered data-careersite-propertyid microdata fields, same pattern as joinus.canalplus.com
Avature ATS, div-based label/value template (no dl/dt/dd)
Teamtailor custom domain (JSON-LD JobPosting present)
Celonis careers page fronts Greenhouse; ?jobId={id} (sometimes double-encoded as ?jobId={id}%3Fgh_jid%3D{id}) maps directly to boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/celonis/jobs/{id}

WP Job Manager plugin (wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings?slug=); free WP job board aggregator. Company in meta._company_name, location/remote-scope only signal is job_listing_region-{slug} class in class_list (JD prose usually has none), employment type in job-type-{slug} class. Apply button href is usually a same-host relative SPA route (/{company-slug}/{uuid}/application, 404s on direct GET) — not an external employer ATS redirect; handler notes internal-vs-external in Other Details.

WTTJ public JSON API (no auth): api.welcometothejungle.com/api/v1/organizations/{org}/jobs/{slug}; org+slug parsed from the page URL path. Page itself 403s via Cloudfront regardless of UA -- always hit the API, never xh the HTML.

Jobgether remote-jobs aggregator: /offer/{id}-{slug} embeds a JobPosting JSON-LD plus a data-offer attribute JSON carrying the resolved employer ATS applyUrl; requires a realistic browser UA (default fetch-jd UA gets 403)

Remotive aggregator: JobPosting JSON-LD (realistic browser UA needed, default UA gets HTTP 400) plus a POST /job/application/{id} JSON-RPC call that resolves the actual employer apply URL (never in the HTML). Title wrapped [Hiring] {role} @{company} — stripped. Prose "📍 Location: ..." line is authoritative over the applicantLocationRequirements country array. Both /remote-jobs/{cat}/{slug}-{id} and older /remote/jobs/{cat}/{slug}-{id} path shapes resolve to the same posting.
Cloudflare-managed-challenge blocks Node's fetch (any UA) but xh passes; page embeds full schema.org JobPosting; no employer ATS — apply is in-house via Turnstile-protected POST

Himalayas remote-jobs aggregator: rendered page is Cloudflare-challenge-walled (xh/firecrawl both blocked or soft-redirected to the generic /jobs listing), but himalayas.app/jobs/api/search?company={org}&page={n} is a free unauthenticated JSON API (docs at himalayas.app/api) that returns the same job by guid == the page URL. No employer ATS URL is ever exposed (Apply routes through Himalayas's own signup funnel), so the Himalayas URL stays canonical; not found in the company's search results means expired. Built-in match() fires on the host pattern so no registry override needed, but entry kept for documentation.

careers page embeds Greenhouse job board via ?gh_jid= query param (not /jobs/{id} path)

Sumsub Teamtailor custom domain; full JobPosting JSON-LD embedded, alternate .md link also available

CatalystOne Teamtailor custom domain

SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing (RMK) template — itemprop microdata + .joblayouttoken-label sidebar, distinct from successfactors_csb's data-careersite-propertyid convention

SAP SuccessFactors Career Site Builder (jobs2web), actual jobs2web.com platform domain (not a vanity front like joinus.canalplus.com/careers.hexion.com); data-careersite-propertyid fields use 'department' not 'dept' so company resolves via hiringOrganization meta fallback (ASSA ABLOY, no Careers suffix to strip); no joblayouttoken-label sidebar (that's the RMK template, distinct) — plain propBalanced description walk covers the full JD cleanly
Oracle Taleo classic (jobdetail.ftl); AJAX-rendered fields need firecrawl; role parsed from post-render document.title pattern 'Job Description - {Role} ({ReqID})'

custom Next.js careers page (getencube.com), no ATS API/JSON-LD; JD body SSR'd in a class="wysiwyg" div, plain xh GET is enough
